integrity: The geometric-smoothness and minimality arguments are symbolic and are complemented by exact finite enumeration for the stated 57-point incidence calculation. All finite checks can be replayed with the included standalone Python program.
scientific_limitations: The optimal degree is proved for the field of seven elements only. The theorem does not classify all tangent-filling cubic curves and does not assert that the twelve-line Fermat arrangement is new. A potentially unindexed earlier tangent realization remains an originality risk.
title: Minimum tangent-filling degree three over \(\mathbb F_7\)
